name: shelf
description: The shelf skill — manage a personal shelf documentation library through the `shelf` CLI: add, find, edit, remove, audit, open, and set up documents. One skill with progressive disclosure; shells out to the CLI and never edits library files directly. Ships in the shelf repo for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Manage a personal shelf documentation library through the `shelf` CLI — add, find, edit, remove, audit, open, and set up documents.
interface.longDescription: One skill with progressive disclosure: a lean SKILL.md routes to per-operation references (add / find / edit / remove / audit / open / init) loaded on demand. Every operation shells out to the `shelf` CLI; the skill classifies intent and confirms, and never edits the catalog or library files directly. Ships in the shelf repo (monorepo) for both Claude Code and Codex.
